text:
morgan: Hey folks — first day, thanks for the kit! I just unpacked the MacBook Pro (M1) and ran through the onboarding guide. Enrollment flow started but FileVault never prompted to enable disk encryption. Also trying to brew install awscli and it says I need admin rights. Anyone can help?

it_support: Welcome! Quick checks: can you paste output of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`? Also which macOS version are you on (Apple menu -> About This Mac)?

morgan: profiles output below:
```
profiles: No configuration profiles installed.
```
and `fdesetup status` returns `FileVault is Off.`
macOS is 13.6 (Ventura).

julia: hmm that profiles output indicates the MDM enrollment didn't complete. Did you connect to the corporate Wi-Fi during the first boot? Enrollment requires the onboarding network or VPN for Private deployments.

morgan: I was on home wifi and then switched to the office network after. I did the out-of-box setup at home and finished sign-in before coming in.

samir: That explains it — company images expect enrollment to happen during OOBE or right after connecting to corp network so the automated DEP profile can be installed. We can push the profile manually but need a device identifier. Can you run `sudo scutil --get ComputerName` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep "Serial"`?

morgan: ComputerName is "morgan-mbp". Serial: C02XXXXXXX1.

it_support: Thanks. I'm going to trigger an MDM re-enroll and a kick for DEP. Should take ~2-5 minutes once pushed. Keep an eye out for a system prompt.

mac-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Triggered DEP re-enrollment for serial C02XXXXXXX1 at 2026-03-23T14:02:30Z.

morgan: got a notification: "Remote management requires installing a profile" — clicked allow but it asked for an admin password to install. I don't have admin creds.

julia: We usually create a temporary local admin so you can approve the profile and install tools. @it_support can you create temp admin for morgan for 24h?

it_support: Created local admin `temp-admin-morgan` and sent password via DM. Use it only to approve the profile and install Homebrew. I'll expire the account in 24h.

morgan: Logged in with temp-admin, approved the profile, and the MDM profile installed. Ran `profiles status -type enrollment` now shows the corporate MDM profile.

it_support: Great. Now enable FileVault: open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> FileVault -> Turn On FileVault. It will ask for iCloud or recovery key; choose recovery key and send it to us encrypted via the secure vault (we already stored one for your device). Alternatively run: `sudo fdesetup enable -user morgan` and follow prompts.

morgan: Ran `sudo fdesetup enable` and it started enabling. `fdesetup status` now shows "Encryption in progress".

julia: Nice. Reminder: encryption can take a bit; leave the machine plugged in overnight.

samir: About Homebrew: now that MDM is installed we can push an enterprise-signed installer, or keep using local admin. If you prefer to install dev tools yourself, use the temp-admin to `arch -arm64 /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"` on M1.

morgan: Brew installed. I could `brew install awscli` and it worked. Thanks.

it_support: I'll deprovision the temp-admin in ~12 hours once you confirm everything is fine. Also scheduled a forced macOS update to 14.0 in 3 days for all new hires; you can opt in earlier if you want.

morgan: All good from my side. FileVault encrypting, MDM shows assigned policies, Homebrew + awscli installed. Thanks everyone for the quick help :tada:

mac-deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Device C02XXXXXXX1 fully enrolled and policies applied at 2026-03-23T14:25:00Z.

it_support: Closing the loop — temp admin will be removed at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z. If you hit any policy blockers (VSCode, Docker permissions), ping us and we can whitelist or push settings.

morgan: Will do. Appreciate it!
